title: How does Raft elect a leader when the old one dies?

glossary.full: A consensus algorithm designed to be understandable
A numbered period with at most one leader

key_points: A silent leader makes a follower time out and start an election.
One vote per term, only for an up-to-date log; a majority wins.
Random timeouts make split votes rare and self-healing.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Three servers. One leader. At three a.m., the leader's power cable gets kicked.
beats.say: Three servers. One leader. At three A M, the leader's power cable gets kicked.

beats.speaker: ana
beats.text: S1 sent heartbeats. Now, silence. Do the others just wait?
beats.say: S one sent heartbeats. Now, silence. Do the others just wait?

beats.speaker: ben
beats.text: They can't wait forever. Each follower runs a random timer: 150 to 300 milliseconds in the Raft paper.

beats.speaker: ben
beats.text: Every time. No heartbeat, the timer runs out. S2's runs out first.
beats.say: Every time. No heartbeat, the timer runs out. S two's runs out first.

beats.speaker: ben
beats.text: S2 becomes a candidate. It adds one to its term, votes for itself, and asks for votes.
beats.say: S two becomes a candidate. It adds one to its term, votes for itself, and asks for votes.

beats.speaker: ana
beats.say: Why would S three say yes?

beats.speaker: ben
beats.text: Each server gives one vote per term, saved to disk first, and only to a candidate whose log is at least as up to date as its own.

beats.speaker: ana
beats.text: That's two votes out of three. A majority.

beats.speaker: ana
beats.text: What if S2 and S3 time out together?
beats.say: What if S two and S three time out together?

beats.speaker: ben
beats.text: A split vote. Each votes for itself, neither gets a majority, and the term ends with no leader.

beats.speaker: ben
beats.text: No. Timers re-randomize, one usually fires first, and it wins in a new term.

beats.speaker: ben
beats.text: If S1 wakes up, any message with a higher term makes it step down.
beats.say: If S one wakes up, any message with a higher term makes it step down.
